items.prompt: Why run an intentionally broken implementation against the suite?

options.text: To permanently replace the correct implementation
options.why: The broken version is a temporary test of test sensitivity.

options.text: To make the final test report show every case passed
options.why: The useful outcome is observing a failure for the injected bug.

options.text: To check whether the tests detect a known wrong behaviour
options.why: A suite that misses an obvious bug may lack meaningful assertions.

options.text: To avoid writing expected outcomes for the test cases
options.why: Failure injection does not remove the need for valid oracles.

items.explanation: An injected known bug tests whether the checks are capable of detecting that defect. It does not establish completeness against every other bug.
